summary: Write normalised constituent rows to resource_type='index_constituents' after indices constituents fetches, and update index-driver SQL to query that resource_type with camelCase field names.
reason: writeThroughCache only persists items with an 'id' field; indexTrackerApi constituent items have no 'id', so nothing was stored. Additionally the old SQL used field names from the dead equity-stockIndices shape ($.meta.indexName, $.index) which don't match the normalised fields from the new endpoint ($.indexName, $.pChange). Result: index-driver silently returned empty results after running indices constituents.
validated_outcome: After running 'indices constituents --index NIFTY 50', resource_type='index_constituents' rows are populated keyed by symbol_indexName with camelCase fields. index-driver --index 'NIFTY 50' returns weighted contributions for 50 stocks.
